descriptions: Information-processing and status acquiring determinants of cultural activities, especially visiting monuments. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure
